name: Comment Thread
description: Nested comment list with author avatars, timestamps, caller-wired reply buttons, and collapsible reply threads.
usage:
<CommentThread
  comments={[
    {
      id: "1",
      author: "Ada Lovelace",
      body: "Looks good overall.",
      timestamp: new Date(),
      replies: [{ id: "1a", author: "Alan Turing", body: "Needs tests." }],
    },
  ]}
  onReply={(comment) => openComposer(comment.id)}
/>

anatomy.description: Author avatar, name, timestamp, and body text laid out in a row.
Caller-wired button rendered on every comment when onReply is provided.
Button that hides a comment's replies and reports the hidden reply count.
Nested replies indented under their parent with a left border.

dos: Wire onReply to your own composer; the thread never owns editing UI.
Pass timestamps and override formatTime to localize them for your audience.
Keep nesting to two or three levels so indentation stays readable.
donts: Don't use it for one-directional event history; use ActivityFeed instead.
Don't truncate comment bodies; let them wrap inside the thread.
Don't put interactive content inside comment bodies; the thread is read-only apart from reply and collapse.

examples.title: Nested thread
examples.description: Renders replies indented under their parent with a collapse toggle that shows the hidden reply count.

examples.title: With reply action
examples.description: Passes onReply so every comment gets a reply button wired to the host application's composer.

guidance.useWhen: Discussions on documents, pull requests, or tickets need nested replies the user can collapse to scan the top level.
guidance.avoidWhen: Events are one-directional history without conversation structure; use ActivityFeed instead.
guidance.behavior: Threads start expanded; the collapse toggle hides a comment's replies and reports the hidden count. Reply actions are fully caller-wired via onReply.
guidance.responsive: Nested replies indent with a left border and keep a single-column layout that wraps at narrow widths.

keyboard.action: Moves focus through reply and collapse buttons.
Activates the focused reply or collapse button.

notes: Comments render as nested lists, so screen readers announce the reply hierarchy.
Collapse toggles expose aria-expanded and name the comment author in their accessible label.

props.description: Top-level comments; each may carry nested `replies`.
props.name: comments

props.description: When provided, each comment shows a reply button that calls this handler.
props.name: onReply
